heading: Annual audits

tree.heading: Annual independent audit
tree.text: The Bureau shall order an annual independent audit of the operations and budget of the Bureau.

tree.heading: Annual GAO audit
tree.text: The Comptroller General of the United States shall conduct an annual audit of the Bureau’s financial statements in accordance with generally accepted government accounting standards.

notes.heading: Initial Audits
notes.text: Pub. L. 112–10, div. B, title V, § 1573(c), Apr. 15, 2011, 125 Stat. 139, provided that the initial audits under this section were to be completed not later than the end of the 180-day period beginning on Apr. 15, 2011.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 111–203, title X, § 1016A, as added Pub. L. 112–10, div. B, title V, § 1573(a), Apr. 15, 2011, 125 Stat. 138.)
